title.narrative: Operation of the emergency center to combat epidemic diseases in Hajjah Governorate

description.narrative: Full readiness of the emergency center for speedy diagnosis and provision of emergency health services to combat epidemics for (43,164) beneficiaries, 95% of the beneficiaries receiving their needs of therapeutic and diagnostic medicines
Providing treatment and isolation services for cases infected with epidemics, field surveys to investigate epidemics and their causes, and health education to prevent them.

Saving life, maintaining its continuity, limiting the spread of diseases and epidemics, and securing emergency health services to combat the epidemic and strengthening them for some liberated districts in Hajjah Governorate.
